title: Missing your ex round: Scorpio
old_caption:
Saved their number as DON'T?
It's okay to miss being known. You can find that feeling again.

title: Flaky friend round: Sagittarius
old_caption:
Cancelled on your friends for the third time this month?
Show up for one small plan. It still counts.

title: New Year round: Capricorn
old_caption:
Long list of resolutions and not one is about love?
Try one soft goal this year: let someone in.

title: The full hot seat: Aquarius
old_caption:
Sixty seconds of rapid questions, and the last one gets real.
Everyone needs one person who sees the whole thing.

title: Twelve signs, one hot seat
old_caption:
Twelve signs, one chair, one question each. Wait for the last one.
Even the bravest sign gets nervous in the hot seat.

title: Totally Over My Ex
old_caption:
The needle did not believe Aries for one second.
Over the ex, sure. The hoodie is a separate case. Who else still sleeps in one?

title: Thriving at the Holiday Dinner
old_caption:
Single at the family dinner and "thriving"? The machine says otherwise.
Taurus loves the rolls. The questions, less so. What's your rehearsed answer this year?

title: Not Waiting for the Text
old_caption:
"I'm not waiting for their text," says Gemini, refreshing for the ninth time.
The only new message was the weather. Be honest, how many times did you check today?

title: I Deleted Our Old Texts
old_caption:
Cancer deleted every old text. Into a folder. Called DO NOT OPEN. Last opened: today.
Missing someone is allowed. Who else has an archive like this?

title: I Didn't Plan What to Say
old_caption:
Virgo is just going to wing tonight's call.
With a script. Draft four. Stage directions included. Which line would you add?
